title: HiDream-O1-Image: 8B Unified Pixel-Space Transformer
summary: A natively unified 8B pixel-space transformer for high-quality image generation and instruction-based editing. It processes text and pixels in a shared token space, enabling native 2K synthesis without VAE artifacts.
research_notes: Ranks among the top open-source models on major benchmarks. Integrates a reasoning-driven agent for layout planning and prompt expansion.

evolution.summary: Open-sourced the 8B weights in May 2026 as a major shift from latent diffusion to pixel-native reasoning models. Current variants include a distilled 'Dev' model and a high-parameter 'Pro' research version.
